COOPERATE: Synchronize blower setpoints across diffusers using the automated aeration controller.

Control aeration blowers independently using only real-time dissolved oxygen measurements from the tank.

DISENGAGE: Shut off blowers and reroute effluent to temporary storage lagoons.
